title: Why 10,211 Meters Doesn't Make Everest Highest
hook: At 10,211 meters, the tallest mountain is not Everest.
closing: Every record depends on where measurement begins, so check the starting point.
question: Which mountain wins for you?

segments.say: Everest reaches 8,849 meters above sea level, which is why most lists call it highest.
Mauna Kea measures 10,211 meters from its base, but most of that mountain is underwater.
Chimborazo extends 13.4 kilometers beyond a round Earth, placing its summit farthest from Earth's center.
